title: NeoGraph step-plan/v1
description: A flat, ordered list of steps written by a planner. Data only: intake_step_plan checks it against the host's template allow-list and lowers it into a TaskGraphProposal. A reference may only name an earlier step. step_plan_json_schema() generates a schema specialised to one catalog; this one is the catalog-independent shape.

output.description: Artifact name. Default: the producer's 'out', else its only artifact.

field.description: Output field without the leading '/'. Default: the artifact's only field.

literal.description: Any JSON value except an object that has the key 'from_step'.

use.description: A template id from the host allow-list.

params.description: Input name (the template's input field without the leading '/') to a literal or a reference.

out.description: A declared output artifact of the template.
